subject: High-fat diets and aging starve key gut microbes, breaching barriers to impair memory
script: From Agewell Brief: High-fat diets and aging starve key gut microbes, breaching barriers to impair memory. The combined strain of aging and high-fat intake starves crucial gut microbes, triggering an inflammatory cascade that breaks colonic seals and impairs memory. When mice reach middle age on a high-fat diet, the living architecture of their gut ecosystem collapses. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
